test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to replace the italicised word.

The little girl had *obsequious *manners.
solution: The correct answer is __**Law-abiding**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • SYNONYM is *a phrase or word with the same or well almost the same meaning as another phrase or word. * • The word **obsequious **means excessively or servilely obedient or attentive. (खुशामदी) • The word **Law-abiding **means following laws and rules. (क़ानून-अनुसारी, क़ानून-पालन करने वाला, विधि-वत्ता, सज़ा विधिवत्) • The meaning of word **obsequious **is similar to the meaning of word **law-abiding***, hence the correct answer is law-abiding.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • The word **Mischievous **means causing or displaying a fondness for causing mischief in a playful manner. (नखरेबाज, शरारती, दुष्ट, नाटकी, कपटी) *Example *: My son is a **Mischievous **boy. • The word **Defiant **means showing defiance, noncooperation. (अवज्ञाकारी, उग्र, विरोधात्मक, प्रतिद्वंद्वी, डटकर खड़ा होना) *Example *: He is always **defiant **to what I say. • The word **Headstrong **means spiritedly wilful and determined. (अड़ियल, जिद्दी, हठी, उद्दंड, अकड़) *Example *: The **Headstrong **impulsiveness of youth. 47:Tb84, The correct answer is **hapless**__
